title: Adaptive Scanning
hook: The shift that hurts your business next year is probably already in the news.
statement: Keep watching outside trends, and act on what you find.
explainer: Competitors move, tools change, customer habits shift. Founders who catch it early adjust cheaply. The ones who don't get blindsided and pay a lot more.
sop: Block a fixed weekly time to scan industry news and competitor moves.
Pull one real takeaway from each scan.
Score Awareness and Responsiveness from 1 to 10.
Test one small tweak based on it within the week.
Log what you scanned and what changed because of it.
equation_example: Awareness 7, Responsiveness 5. 7 × 5 = 35. Higher means you spot shifts early and move fast. Lower means you're either not watching, or watching and doing nothing.
question: Write down one outside trend that could shake up your next 12 months.
closing_statement: Watching without acting is just reading the news.
caption:
Principle Nº 203: Adaptive Scanning

The shift that hurts your business next year is probably already in the news.

Keep watching outside trends, and act on what you find.

Your turn: Write down one outside trend that could shake up your next 12 months.
